pages.title: Contact
pages.body: Questions about sizing, gifts or an order? Send us a message and we'll get back to you within one business day.

policies.SHIPPING_POLICY:
Orders ship within 1-2 business days from our warehouse. Standard shipping within the United States takes 3-7 business days.

Shipping is free on orders over $50. Orders under $50 pay a flat standard rate shown at checkout.

You'll get a tracking link by email as soon as your order ships.
policies.REFUND_POLICY:
We accept returns and exchanges of unworn, unwashed items with tags attached within 30 days of delivery.

To start a return, contact us with your order number. Once we receive and check your return, we'll refund the original payment method within 5 business days.

For hygiene reasons, opened scratch mittens and socks can't be returned unless they arrived faulty.
